pass_rule: Non-English primary evidence workflow tested; no score advantage is created merely by English-language or web-marketing intensity.
interpretation_rule: Synthetic invariance proves only that language, region and marketing intensity are excluded from the formula when evidence quality and mission relevance are held constant. G09 still requires real non-English and cross-regional evidence workflow tests.
blockers_to_start: No frozen Pilot 20 with meaningful regional and language diversity exists.
No authorised non-English primary-evidence workflow has been exercised on real Pilot 20 cases.
No real comparison of English-rich versus non-English evidence discoverability exists.
No human review of regional/language missingness patterns has occurred.
human_gate: Software may detect score drift linked to language/region proxies, but only authorised methodological review may conclude that the workflow is fair enough for G09 to pass.
